big: A client has ₹60 lakh, but ₹55 lakh of it is her only savings. Should she put ₹50 lakh in a PMS? No. These products suit those with a solid core already in place.

lines: Who is right for these products?

Clients with a solid core of liquid investments, adequate insurance and an emergency fund. They need to take higher risk, lock in money for years and understand the strategy. Not for money needed soon, for first-time investors, or for those who cannot bear large swings. A PMS may hold 15 to 25 stocks, so one bad bet is more visible.
